name: Collection Account Detail
description: Superuser inspects one cuenta de cobro without leaving the tab: the row shows Cliente and Proyecto as separate columns, and the detail modal carries the linked income with its settlement history plus the emitted document in a Documento tab. Going to the income is the optional exit and must land on a tab that does not filter the focused row out. With a zero-day term there is no vencimiento, so the Emisión / Vence cell shrinks to Emisión over a single date instead of pairing it with an em-dash that reads as missing data. The Documento tab probes the inline PDF URL before embedding it — spinner while it resolves, and when the document cannot render, a message in the app's own words pointing at Descargar PDF instead of the browser's refused-connection page. IVA (2026-10): El resumen muestra base, IVA registrado y total de la cuenta, además del desglose independiente del ingreso vinculado. Las cuentas de hosting también muestran IVA; un histórico sin tasa se distingue de Sin IVA.
